race.description: Team Aidan Markets @ Crjc 22 Nov Hcp (C2)
race.comment: HARD AS BROK (4) handy gelding resuming. Came to the end of his prep with a tiring last over 1600m at Eagle Farm on July 29. Fitted with the 1000m trial win and gets a senior jockey from the good barrier. Top three contender. COPENHAGEN CAT (8) has her hoof on the till after the three sound runs and will relish the 4kg claim again. Was a month between runs when nailed late to run second over 1200m here. Similar set-up today and sure to be thereabouts. CITY OF TEARS (3) fourth up for this and finally drawn a decent barrier. Shouldered the 58kg for a gritty fifth over 1014m at Coffs Harbour. Senior rider goes on for this and no surprise to see her take this out. PRINCE OF PROPHETS (2) resumes. Came to the end of his prep on the heavy surface with a plugging fifth over 1400m at Coffs Harbour last April. Claim helps and look for him late.
